name: icloud
description: iCloud Mail, Calendar, and Contacts through an app-specific password. Bundles the icloud-mail-calendar-contacts-mcp server with a skill for safe everyday use.

icloud_app_password.title: App-specific password
icloud_app_password.description: Generate one at account.apple.com > Sign-In and Security > App-Specific Passwords. Not your Apple Account password.

icloud_timezone.title: Time zone
icloud_timezone.description: IANA zone used for calendar times, for example Europe/Prague.

icloud_read_only.title: Read-only
icloud_read_only.description: Turn off every write tool: no sending, filing, or calendar and contact changes.

icloud_allow_send.title: Allow sending email
icloud_allow_send.description: Let the agent send mail. When off, it can still save drafts for you to send.

icloud_allow_delete.title: Allow delete
icloud_allow_delete.description: Let the agent move mail to Trash and delete events and contacts. Permanent expunge stays off.
